title: Refactor auth client to use official better-auth createAuthClient
body:
## Problem
Current client implementation uses a custom `createAuthClient` instead of the official better-auth client, leading to several integration bugs:

- Client does not leverage the full feature set of official better-auth client (OAuth, magic links, session hooks, etc.)
- Type mismatches and manual request handling increase maintenance burden and introduce hard-to-debug edge cases

## Recommended Fix

**Priority refactor:**

1. Replace custom `createAuthClient` with official `better-auth/react` or `better-auth/client` (`createAuthClient`) and migrate usage accordingly.
